principles: One canonical cache in the main checkout; resolve to it from anywhere (worktree or main).
Centralize the fix in learning-store (the only cache toucher) so all consumers inherit it.
Fail safe: any git-resolution failure falls back to the passed root; never throw into story_review / learning_*.
Minimal blast radius: learning-store path resolution + one smoke; plain/non-git layouts byte-identical.
drivers: The Experience Layer is built but dormant ONLY because the worktree cannot reach the main-checkout cache (nOn=2).
git rev-parse --git-common-dir deterministically yields the main root from any worktree; for the main checkout it yields the same root (no behavior change).
Existing experience-layer smokes use non-git temp roots, so a fallback is mandatory to avoid regressions.

options.name: resolve-to-git-common-dir-parent
pros: Centralized in learning-store; all consumers fixed at once.
cons: Adds a git subprocess to learning-store reads (cheap; cached/one-shot).

options.name: copy-or-symlink-cache-into-each-worktree
cons: Duplication + staleness (a worktree copy goes stale vs main); cleanup hazard; worktree creation must learn about the cache.

options.name: resolve-in-each-caller-and-pass-down
cons: Must change every caller (story-review, 3 learning handlers); easy to miss one; duplicated resolution logic.

rationale: Resolving the learning dir to the parent of git rev-parse --git-common-dir inside learning-store (the single cache toucher), with a fallback to the passed root on failure, makes one canonical main-checkout cache reachable from every worktree, fixes all consumers at once, and keeps non-git/plain layouts byte-identical — the smallest correct change to revive the dormant Experience Layer.

preMortem.scenario: The git-resolution has no fallback, so non-git temp-dir smokes throw or read the wrong place.
preMortem.trigger: Assuming every root is a git worktree.
preMortem.consequence: Existing experience-layer smokes break; learning_* throws.
preMortem.mitigation: try/catch the git rev-parse; on ANY failure/empty, return the passed root unchanged; the new smoke includes a non-git control asserting fallback; run the existing experience-layer smokes.

preMortem.scenario: git-common-dir is resolved relative to the wrong cwd, yielding a bad main root.
preMortem.trigger: Not running git rev-parse with cwd=passed root, or not resolving the relative ../../.git to an absolute path.
preMortem.consequence: Cache read/written at a wrong location → still no hints, or a stray cache.
preMortem.mitigation: Run git rev-parse --git-common-dir with cwd=root, path.resolve(root, commonDir, ..) to an absolute main root; the smoke asserts the worktree reads the MAIN cache path specifically.

preMortem.scenario: learning_scan now writes to the resolved main root, but a reader still uses the old (worktree) path → split-brain.
preMortem.trigger: Fixing read XOR write, not both.
preMortem.consequence: Writes and reads disagree; hints still empty.
preMortem.mitigation: Apply the SAME resolveLearningRoot to both the read and write paths in learning-store; the smoke writes via the store then reads via the store from the worktree and asserts a hit.
